scope: Schematic electrical topology only; PCB layout and physical validation are separate
checks: USB VBUS is directly on LED VCC; no DC input, power-path diodes, source switches or boost converter
GPIO16 and GPIO17 use permanently enabled 5V AHCT buffers and separate 100-ohm output resistors
BOOT and GPIO18 have separate 10k pull-ups and Schottky isolation to the shared button
Original synchronous buck topology and nominal 3.3V feedback ratio retained
0805 zero-ohm R106 bridges VDDA55/56 and C105 from 3V3 while C106 retains the main supply
ESP32-S3FH4R2 has 4MB in-package Quad-SPI flash and 2MB Quad-SPI PSRAM; seven memory pads reserved/NC and VDD_SPI bypassing retained
FH4R2 fixed 3.3V VDD_SPI needs no GPIO45 pulldown; GPIO46 boot pulldown retained
Ceramic antenna and native USB ESD/data connections retained
Optional UART testpads omitted; UART GPIO43/44 left unconnected, native USB retained
LX0001 core pinout, supply, crystal and RF values preserved except FH4R2 memory migration, VDDA jumper bridge, equivalent 2.7nH 0201 L102 sourcing substitution and omitted UART debug nets
usb_power: Direct nominal 5V, no PD and no onboard input current limiter. Total current includes controller and strip.
